business_problem: Mega Lake Project—data democratization within CPFL CPFL decided to face the challenge of providing faster delivery of a larger volume of data so that its business areas could perform better analysis and positively impact executive decision making company-wide.
solution_summary: CPFL used Power Platform, Power Automate, Power BI to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. Based on a strategic decision to make more data available at a faster pace, CPFL started the Mega Lake project using Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Power Platform tools. The architecture emphasizes managed services, reusable integrations, and governed data handling so the organization can scale adoption without rebuilding the solution for each new team or use case.
